pure_steps.name: actions/checkout@v4
Refuser un diff hors du périmètre documentaire avant les contrôles
pure_steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY_SCOPE'
import os, re, subprocess
base = os.environ.get("BASE_SHA", "")
if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", base):
    raise SystemExit("Refus : SHA de base PR invalide ou absent.")
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", "-z", f"{base}...HEAD"],
    check=True, capture_output=True,
)
paths = [p.decode("utf-8") for p in result.stdout.split(b"\0") if p]
exact = {"AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md", "apps/web/src/modules/README.md",
         ".github/workflows/ci.yml", ".github/workflows/codex-missions.yml"}
unexpected = [p for p in paths if not (p.startswith(("docs/", "Studio/")) or p in exact)]
if unexpected:
    print("Refus : le diff contient des fichiers hors du périmètre documentaire :")
    for path in unexpected:
        print(ascii(path))
    raise SystemExit(1)
print(f"Périmètre documentaire vérifié : {len(paths)} chemins ; aucune source applicative hors allowlist.")
PY_SCOPE
